verdict.rationale: Drata documents a Public APIv2 with OAuth setup and an OpenAPI reference covering read and write operations across the product: create/update controls, policies and versions, evidence library items, custom frameworks, custom connections, devices, risks, audits, monitoring tests and personnel. That is enough to drive the product programmatically. Probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, though the reference is published under /openapi/reference/v2, and some endpoints are marked experimental. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and a fetchable machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the standard paths.
